programs.title: Lobstermania: The Deep Dive
programs.desc: Brave the treacherous seas with three charismatic skippers as they battle the elements and each other during Tasmania's high-stakes lobster season. A detailed exploration and analysis of the season's lobster hunting archive with new themes.

programs.title: How Do They Do It?
programs.sub_title: Pearls, Damascus Steel Knives and Hippo Rollers
programs.desc: How do they grow America's only freshwater pearls in Tennessee? How are the world's sharpest knives made, and how do they forge the world's sharpest knives?

programs.title: How Do They Do It?
programs.sub_title: Sugar Beets, Feather Dusters and Balloons
programs.desc: How do they turn root vegetables into sweet sugar? How do they make feather dusters? And, how do they make billions of balloons to keep parties popping?

programs.title: Drive
programs.desc: The ever popular Mini has been fully electrified, which is all the excuse Emma needs to go for a spirited cross-country drive to a racetrack.

programs.title: Tanked
programs.desc: Brett and Wayde are challenged to turn an entire Toyota Highlander into an aquarium while simultaneously opening a new ATM office in South Florida. Brett decides to turn a vintage slot machine into a tank to bring a little bit of Vegas to South Florida.

programs.title: Salvage Hunters
programs.desc: Salvage expert Drew Pritchard does battle at a castle in Essex, and an antiques emporium in Berkshire holds anatomical interest. Drew drives a hard bargain on automobile memorabilia in Lancashire.
